text:
Alex H.: Heads-up — need approval for a reserved GPU commitment in us-west2 (NVIDIA A100 80GB). Short summary + ask below.
Maria L.: ok can you drop the numbers here?
Alex H.: TL;DR: propose staged commitment to reduce unit cost for high-throughput inference workloads. Pilot 12 GPUs (1yr) -> scale to 24 GPUs (1–3yr) if utilization holds.
Alex H.: Rough cost calc (quick back-of-envelope):
```
On-demand:    $2.30 / GPU / hr
Reserved 1yr:  $1.20 / GPU / hr (estimated)
Reserved 3yr:  $0.85 / GPU / hr (estimated)
Delta (1yr):   ~$1.10 / hr / GPU
Delta (3yr):   ~$1.45 / hr / GPU
Annual savings @12 GPUs (1yr): 1.10 * 12 * 24 * 365 ≈ $115k
Annual savings @24 GPUs (3yr): 1.45 * 24 * 24 * 365 ≈ $304k
```
Priya S.: those estimates look plausible. what's the total committed spend we would need for the pilot?
Alex H.: Pilot 12 GPUs 1yr reserved => approx reserved price * 12 * 8760 ≈ $126k (paid as monthly amortization or 1x invoice depending on Finance). Will confirm exact quote from cloud sales.
Sam T.: Ops caveats: networking in us-west2 is constrained right now — we'll need to request an increase on subnet IPs and bump the NIC quota for 100Gb attachments. Also filesystem throughput quotas for inference pods.
Sam T.: also we should account for node prep time: kernel, driver, and our kernel-level optimizations need a maintenance window.
Maria L.: risk profile? if models migrate to H100 or we move to quantized LLMs, we could underutilize A100s.
Alex H.: Agreed. Mitigations: convertible reservations / regional fallback (route low-priority jobs to on-demand in us-east1) / autoscale down non-critical fleets. Proposal includes a staged buy: 12 -> monitor 3 months -> commit to 24.
Priya S.: can we include a clause to trade or resell capacity in the marketplace if usage drops? Some providers allow marketplace transfer.
Alex H.: Will check with sales. Good idea.
Finance Bot: Please attach the vendor quote and preferred billing cadence. Approval path: Eng Lead -> Finance Director -> CFO for commitments > $250k. Provide GL codes and cost center (use ENG-INFRA).
Maria L.: Finance: can we do monthly amortization to avoid a lump sum impacting this quarter's burn?
Finance Bot: Monthly amortization possible for 1yr commitments; 3yr typically handled differently (capex vs operating) depending on accounting policy. I'll loop in Accounting.
Priya S.: alternate approach: start with reserved GPU share via Dedicated pool (internal sandbox) so product teams can buy usage credits on top — reduces central financial exposure.
Alex H.: That needs product/console work but good long-term model. For now recommend pilot 12 GPUs 1yr reserved. Next steps I propose:
 - Ops: open subnet & NIC quota requests (Sam)
 - Alex: get exact cloud sales quote + marketplace terms
 - Finance: draft PO & suggested billing cadence; confirm approval chain
 - Eng Lead: sign off on pilot
Can we aim to get approvals and a PO within 2 weeks?
Finance Bot: I'll draft a PO for a 1yr 12-GPU reservation and produce a 12-month amortization schedule. Need final quote to lock numbers.
Oncall Bot: FYI — reservation provisioning will trigger a short maintenance window for node image baking. Tentative slot proposed: 2025-06-10 02:00 UTC (confirm after PO).
Sam T.: noted +1 on the maintenance slot. I will open the quota requests today and post the tracking ticket.
Maria L.: sounds good — endorsing pilot.
Priya S.: +1 — prefer the staged approach to reduce risk.
Alex H.: Awesome — I'll post the quote and the internal spreadsheet link here once I have the final numbers from sales. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
